findings.issue: Content-Security-Policy sets script-src 'self' with no 'unsafe-inline'/nonce/hash, but same diff adds inline <script type="application/ld+json"> blocks in Layout.astro and index.astro. Browsers apply CSP script-src to all <script> elements regardless of type; strict script-src blocks these inline scripts from parsing, so crawlers/tools never see structured data. Feature added in this diff is broken by config added in same diff.
findings.fix: Add a nonce or hash for the JSON-LD scripts, or scope CSP with 'unsafe-inline' only for script-src, or move structured data to a .json fetched with src (still requires allowlisting) - simplest fix: add sha256 hash of each inline script to script-src, or exclude type=application/ld+json handling via nonce set per request (Astro static site: precompute hash and add to CSP).

findings.issue: New dependency tree (@astrojs/sitemap and transitive deps: sitemap, zod 4.x, sax, arg, stream-replace-string) added without visible audit; devDependency only so not shipped to prod bundle, but adds build-time supply chain surface.
findings.fix: Run npm audit / review new transitive deps before merge; not blocking since devDependency-only.

findings.issue: Org/site URLs (https://keeplings.watersedgegames.com/...) hardcoded in JSON-LD instead of derived from Astro.site, which is already available and used for canonicalURL/ogImage just above.
findings.fix: Build these from Astro.site (e.g. new URL('#org', Astro.site)) to avoid drift if domain changes.

feat(site): add SEO metadata, sitemap, and social share tags

Set the Astro site URL and add @astrojs/sitemap so every page emits a
self-referencing canonical and a matching extensionless sitemap. Add
Open Graph and Twitter card tags with a 1200x630 image, sitewide
Organization plus WebSite JSON-LD, and SoftwareApplication markup on the
homepage. Add robots.txt (with the sitemap pointer), llms.txt, and a
branded noindex 404 page. Switch internal links to extensionless and
301 the .html forms to clean URLs in Netlify, and add a security-header
block (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options,
Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy).
